title: Where to See Flamingos in Tanzania
excerpt: Pink flocks on soda lakes: where to see flamingos in Tanzania and why they gather there.
body:
## Two species

Lesser flamingos (smaller, darker pink) and greater flamingos.

## Soda lakes

They feed on algae and small organisms in alkaline lakes.

## Where

- [Lake Natron](/blog/lake-natron-guide/), the main breeding site for lesser flamingos in East Africa.
- Lake Manyara.
- The soda lake in the Ngorongoro Crater.
- Momella Lakes in Arusha National Park.
- Empakaai Crater.
- Lake Ndutu.

## Numbers vary

Flamingos move between lakes depending on water levels.
